audit.why: Hwei outranges Alistar's melee combo pre-6; the level chart correctly gives every stage to Hwei and the packet's levelChart (all 7 rows Hwei) agrees with content win[0..6]=Hwei.

Spikes correctly track Hwei's poke lvl2, Spiraling Despair (R) at 6, and Malignance/Liandry's at first item; Alistar's own spikes (E stun stacks, R at 6, first item frontline) are covered in phases[] and breakdown.spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: The fabricated ability name "Subject: Fear (CC Paints)" appears repeatedly (winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t, report[9].t). Hwei has no ability called Subject: Fear. His CC lives on E, Subject: Torment (which becomes Grim Visage / Gaze of the Abyss / Crushing Maw). Also missing: his W, Subject: Serenity, casts a shield form (Pool of Reflection) that absorbs burst and changes all-in math — currently unmentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Riot's kit text and enemyAbilities confirm E = Subject: Torment (the CC-form ability, cd 12/11.5/11/10.5/10) and W = Subject: Serenity (utility/shield forms). "Subject: Fear" does not exist in the kit data.
audit.corrected: Replace every instance of Subject: Fear (CC Paints) with Subject: Torment (E), and add the W shield note to the Key Ability Interactions report entry.
